verdict.rationale: Sift is an ML-based fraud-detection SaaS that ingests customer event data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no opt-out, data-exclusion setting, or contractual control over model training. The docs instead say Sift 'gets smarter the more data it has about your business', which points to customer data being used to improve its models.
